description: The 2020 National Hydropower Map, Version 1: A Visualization of the Geospatial Distribution and Characteristics of Operational Hydropower Plants in the United States in 2020 is a data set deposited in DOE Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) Repository by its authors Nicole Samu (Oak Ridge National Lab. (ORNL), Oak Ridge, TN (United States)). This map poster uses Oak Ridge National Laboratory’s Existing Hydropower Assets Plant Dataset FY20 to visualize the geospatial distribution and characteristics of existing hydropower plants in the United States.
